scenario: Chinese client with a no-cheat integrated survival world. Original mod set and prepared starting cabin, workbench and crafting ingredients.
actions: Craft the chart terminal in the recipe book, open the normal first-flight guide and click Surface survey.
Use the GUI to mark the ship underfoot, leave the screen and walk to a different column.
Use the reboundable sneak and use controls on the held terminal to reopen the survey. Mark the site and try to overwrite the ship mark without confirming.
Select the ship bearing, change scale and walk back to the original column using the movement keys. Reopen the terminal normally.
otherResult: The same client subsequently checked both starter recipes and followed the native tower recipe to a steel rod.
limits: Two adjacent columns in the Overworld. This measures personal map controls and save persistence. Walking from a lunar landing to an original dungeon needs its own test.
